checks.observed: Actual PLAN plus two in-memory hooks yields the same confirmed plan/prices/shares. Original request replay adds no rows or metadata writes.
14 handled interruption/lost-response boundaries recover through the original request, with no repeated business rows.

Two acceptance failures: PREPARED exists before the candidate pending marker, so candidate misses a pending save; after final business event but before state publication candidate blocks a save already confirmed by the existing reader. These are NOT accepted behavior changes.
Actual company journal rejects a second concurrent PLAN; unrelated root remains readable. This does not prove all other writers share the same coordination.
A replacement request is rejected while the original save is incomplete; the original request still recovers.
An unchanged prior-month confirmed plan is readable without fetching old-month Activity. This is a stored-state date fixture, not a real month-close test.
For this one-root PLAN reader, 0/1000/100000 unrelated rows require one task-ID read, no Activity query and no writes. Full Purchase page is NOT replaced.
Wrong company, missing state and payload/hash mismatch stop explicitly; no zero default, automatic initialization or history fallback. Hash is an integrity check, not a security signature.
Explicit offline initialization is no-op when equal and refuses conflicting or pending records. It never silently overwrites confirmed values.
Real PO assignment, not instrumented in this PLAN-only experiment, changes task version and makes candidate stop. Updating PLAN alone is insufficient.

Counterexample: an uncoordinated stale whole-task update can roll back a valid state envelope without changing taskEditVersion. Existing-item reuse requires all writers to preserve current metadata under compatible locks; candidate NOT production-ready.
20 actual PLAN revisions replace one metadata envelope, adding zero extra CMS rows but 40 extra metadata writes. Existing journal/event rows are unchanged and still grow.

Actual ADD_SOURCE200+50 leaves root taskEditVersion unchanged; PLAN-only candidate silently returns200 and one source, while actual history confirms250 and two sources. All source writers must publish the same root state; this is a candidate bug, not a live regression.

limitations: Only PLAN for existing root tasks is instrumented; PO, ADD_SOURCE, SPECIAL and other writers are not migrated.
Initialization and commit oracle still read full in-memory history. This does not solve save preparation or full-page dependencies.
No Wix transaction, conditional-update, actual query latency or million-row capacity claim.
Task metadata is a feasibility candidate; storage field, migration and production writes are NOT approved.
Handled exceptions run existing finally cleanup; abrupt worker termination and stale-lock takeover are NOT simulated as recovered.

blockers: Real PO assignment conflicts and ADD_SOURCE silently misses new source
